response.sql: WITH state_accounts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base FROM Customers AS c LEFT JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT account_base, 1.0 * account_base / NULLIF(SUM(account_base) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_accounts), compared AS (SELECT account_base, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_states FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(account_base) AS combined_account_base, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_states) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_across_states;
